patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 6's modeled subsystems and actions are supported by the read patent passages: inner/outer plates and typical drive/driven connections (040fd0be41be07c8200a1b8730b10508), axially sliding ratchet and complementary one-way tooth engagement (d4a367ad599d952af54b7da3ae75011c; 45b54ec9c307ee9e78371ee9e82f8f3f; 27c87e3ae2a6ee4ff07b7e04d8ef367b), hydraulic supply/removal and aperture venting (0e7cac9f69b884fee92b6aedb93e85e2; 9959eb84bc6d2928e18938e97a875da1), and torque-responsive angled features (45b54ec9c307ee9e78371ee9e82f8f3f; b153945c0faf81b217005bd48c6d386e).

functional_completeness.rationale: Major disclosed physical elements and behavioral capabilities remain represented. The revision removes standalone flows that lacked endpoints instead of asserting fabricated interface topology. Relevant torque, hydraulic bias, engagement/slippage, and torque-to-thrust behaviors remain in action descriptions. It is acceptable that optional ports/interfaces are omitted where no connected model topology is asserted.

flow_consistency.rationale: The four previously disconnected item_flows have been removed; item_flows is empty, so there are no unconnected flow declarations or inconsistent flow direction/type. Hydraulic removal from cavity 70 and tooth-aperture venting remain distinctly described within ACT-HYD, without being modeled as connected flows.

claim_traceability.rationale: No unsupported normative requirements are present; requirements is empty. Claim-supported behaviors are represented as actions rather than invented obligations. The torque-to-axial-thrust action is explicitly retained and supported by the patent's angled-spline claim passage.

interfaces.rationale: There are no declared ports or interfaces, and no item flows purporting to represent external connections. Descriptive subsystem relationships and typical drive/driven member assignments are supported. Omitting an ungrounded or incomplete interface model is preferable to fabricated connectivity.

textbook_application.rationale: The consulted guidance supports keeping subsystem responsibilities and physical decomposition clear; it does not establish invention facts. The model distinguishes internal transformations/behavior from connected external flows by retaining actions while removing unsupported standalone flow declarations.

summary: Independent review of SJS revision 6: prior connectivity findings are resolved by removing the disconnected item_flows, rather than adding speculative ports or endpoints. Hydraulic port-mediated supply/removal is not conflated with venting through tooth apertures; ACT-HYD clearly distinguishes these mechanisms and limits the port 64b statement to the detailed description. ACT-TORQUE-THRUST remains present and supported. Requirements remain empty, so no unsupported normative wording is asserted. The cited physical components and behavior are adequately patent-grounded; no actionable issues found. Textbook guidance informs modeling choices only. No candidate edits made.
